c74object.name: gst.median
c74object.description:
gst.median removes local noise or clicks in the signal.
Uses pipo.median of MuBu package from ISMM team
at IRCAM Centre Pompidou http://ismm.ircam.fr/pipo/.
The median is the middle value of a sorted data set, dividing the series into two equal parts, with 50% of the values less than or equal to and 50% greater than or equal to. It is calculated on a generally odd number of values (a window of n values advancing step by step according to the flow of incoming values).
These values are organized in ascending order and the median value is the central value of this organization: for a window of 5 values organized in ascending order,
the median value is the 3rd value. [7 35 9 5 6] gives [5 6 7 9 35] :
the median value is 7.
This means that a locally inconsistent value will be eliminated from the result. This filtering removes local noise from a signal and is often used in image processing. For an odd size the delay is approximately (size-1)/2.

inlet.description: number of values for the internal median filter (see pipo.median and gst.median)
